Retire cumulative per-cell dividers after MAX C0..C8 ADC channels are commissioned.
Remove retired cumulative TEST injection branches; only if TEST has no remaining independent use.

reused_parts.reuse: MAX C1-C0..C8-C7 differential filter capacitors; do not delete.
Move/use as MAX SW1..SW8 series cell-balance current limit; at 2.45V ideal current≤20.4mA; do not increase to figure-4 22Ω without thermal review.
Keep TLV6700 total-stack OVP. Change VDD 12V_DRV→3V3_CORE and move OUTB from DRV_FAULT_N to AFE_OK; existing 100nF C_SC_OV_VDD retained if layout permits.
Keep driver-node pull-down; recommend change 10kΩ→47kΩ to improve the AND-VOH margin, then recheck powered-off default and DRV input noise.

wiring_contract: MAX C0..C8 measure eight adjacent LICAP cells: C0=SC_MINUS, C1=T1, ... C7=T7, C8=SC_PLUS. R_MAX_C0..C8 are the manufacturer example 1k series filters. Reuse each C_BALn=100nF across Cn/Cn-1. Keep SC_MINUS↔GND_SYS connected only through the existing 0.5mΩ power shunt; no AFE ground wire may bypass it.

Reuse R_BAL1..8=120Ω from physical cell taps to SW1..SW8 as balancing current-limit resistors; SW0=SC_MINUS. Tie unused C9..C14 together and unused SW9..SW14 together; mask nonexistent channels, set TOPCELL1/2=8 and CELLEN=0x00FF. Leave VBLK unused because existing TLV6700 total OVP remains.

SPI: G431 PB3=SCLK→MAX RXLP, PB4=MOSI→MAX TXLN/SDI, PB9=MISO←MAX TXLP/SDO, PA15=CSB→MAX TXUP/CSB. Use bit-banged SPI to preserve PB5 permit and PA8/PB13 PWM. MAX UARTSEL=AGND; SHDNL is enabled from 3V3_CORE through10k with1nF to AGND and47k pulldown to AGND. VDDL1/2/3 all tie VAA; GNDL1/2/3=GND_SYS; AGND/AUXGND=SC_MINUS. Unused RX UART pins may be tied directly to their GNDL; ALERTIN unused in SPI.

MAX alert: set SPI open-drain mode SPIDRVINT=0 and ALERTEN=1. ALERTOUT active-low, pulled to VDDL2 by10k and wire-ORed with existing TLV6700 OUTB to AFE_OK. AFE_OK also has47k pulldown and drives SN74LVC1G11 input A, so MAX power loss or OVP inhibits the gate independent of G431. Keep total OVP TLV comparator on the same fault input; do not connect push-pull Y to the open-drain alert node.

TPS3850G33: monitor 3V3_CORE. CWD=10k to VDD; SET0=SET1=GND; CRST=NC. Wire RESET and WDO open-drain outputs together to G431 NRST and WD_OK, use one10k pull-up to3V3_CORE and one47k pulldown. WDI is PC11, kept low by47k during reset. Issue falling-edge heartbeat only after both a complete fresh bipolar ADC scan and a complete fresh unipolar comparator scan, with SCANDONE=1, DATARDY=1, SCANTIMEOUT=0, no rejected-scan/PEC/diagnostic fault, and all eight results/statuses read valid. Run paired scan at20ms; heartbeat interval must stay >10.35ms and <92.7ms guaranteed window. First pulse must be before92.7ms after RESET release.

Configure MAX in single-buffer mode so scan data transfers at scan completion; clear SCANDONE/SCANTIMEOUT/DATARDY before each scan, require each scan to be accepted and completed, read current output registers, and verify PEC/status before WDI. The ADC scan uses bipolar polarity for all eight 0V-capable channels; separately run comparator scan with all channels unipolar. Do not count a prior scan/register image as fresh.

SN74LVC1G11 Y drives DRV8161 pin4 via680Ω; keep local pull-down on DRV_FAULT_N. Inputs are AFE_OK, WD_OK and PB5 permit. PB5 remains low/high-Z by reset default, with existing PB5 series resistor changed to4.7k and 47k input pulldown. AFE alert/total OVP, supervisor RESET, watchdog WDO and G431 permit all have a direct hardware path to disable the driver.

For 0V charge, hold gate permit low through reset/configuration. After MAX ID/config/diagnostic checks and an initial fresh scan pair, use the existing DRV8161+G431 buck current loop; low-side pulse/bootstrapping and SO zero-offset acquisition precede high-side PWM. Soft-start to20A cap current; enforce a30A design ceiling. Cell balancing remains disabled during initial charge. No dedicated resistor precharge leg is added.

charge_and_threshold_math.safety_note: The 30A current is a design maximum input, not a proven guarantee of the existing DRV SO path. DRV8161 datasheet p12 offset is ±1.94mV at25°C plus8µV/°C drift; with0.5mΩ×20V/V this is roughly±5.5A at hot/cold endpoints before shunt/gain errors. If uncalibrated actual peak may approach35.5A, recompute OVP rise as~18.4mV, still below2.7V with>0.20V margin. Verify current calibration/COMP trip and SOA in human bench qualification.

delta_summary: 43 added instances, 42 retired instances (net +1 instance, not a claim of lower total BOM cost). The common DRV_FAULT_N readback interface U_DRV_FAULT_FB SN74AUP1T14DCKR + C_DRV_FAULT_FB 100nF is deliberately outside this 43 and should be counted once by the shared gate_shutdown package; it reads actual DRV_FAULT_N and cannot be replaced by MAX ALERTOUT, which reports AFE alerts only.

comparison.result: Selected schematic candidate. Keeps current G431 PWM/DRV MOS stage and adds MAX monitor. MAX can be externally powered from 12V_DRV while the cap stack is 0V; current loop uses existing SO/shunt/inductor path; no separate resistor stage.

LT8228 is itself capable of current limiting over VOUT=0–100V and supports buck V1→V2 plus reverse boost. It cannot replace the MAX per-cell 0V measurement/OV scan. Official full typical application uses M2/M3 main FETs plus M1A/B and M4A/B protection FETs (6 MOSFETs), 2 current shunts, 2 loop-compensation networks, ISET/UV/FB dividers, inrush/timer and multiple bypass parts. If using LT8228, retain at least required V2 back-to-back protection for cap-side fault isolation; do not presume total peripheral count falls. LCSC core prices reported by parent: LT8228HFE#PBF C673654 ¥140.12; MAX17853ACB/V+ C7451746 ¥113.57, pair ¥253.69 before passives/MOSFETs, vs only MAX incremental for retained DRV.

Not suitable as the frozen 0V safeguard: cumulative tap subtraction has accumulated divider/ADC/reference/ground errors; BW6101 IOUT is balancing, not series cutoff, and its LED output lacks guaranteed logic levels/propagation for a hard permit. Replace only after MAX wiring/ALERT path is implemented; reuse existing balance resistors/caps.

later_human_validation_not_blocking_sche: No PCB or firmware performed. Validate 0V boot/scan sequencing, alert polarity/OV hard inhibit, startup below2.7V at every cell, max actual cap current including SO offset and shunt tolerances, 0–60°C cell temperature rise and repetitive charge duty, 12V_DRV transient/power budget, SC_MINUS/GND_SYS common-mode/no-shunt-bypass, watchdog WDI timing at all corners, and the shared gate readback/logic voltage noise margin.
